title: Tab readers on the reviewed crops

metrics.label: Note F1
metrics.description: Bar, onset, string and fret all right.

metrics.label: Note P
metrics.description: Notes the reading wrote that are in the gold.

metrics.label: Fret F1
metrics.description: Note F1 with the string left out: the gap is digits on the wrong line.

metrics.label: Rhythm
metrics.description: Gold slots whose onset, value and rest the reading has.

metrics.label: Bars
metrics.description: Exercises read with the gold's number of bars.

metrics.label: Exact
metrics.description: Exercises read without a single difference.

metrics.label: Drafted
metrics.description: Exercises the parse made a draft for; a dropped one misses every note.

metrics.label: Chord names
metrics.description: Chord exercises whose printed names the reading has in order.

metrics.label: Chords placed
metrics.description: Gold chord changes the reading puts on the same note.

metrics.label: Flag P
metrics.description: Notes the jianpu cross-check flagged that are wrong.

metrics.label: Flag R
metrics.description: Wrong notes the jianpu cross-check flagged.

metrics.label: Links F1
metrics.description: Ties, hammers, pulls and slides on the right note.

metrics.label: Effects F1
metrics.description: Bends, vibrato, accents, pick direction and the rest, on the right note.

metrics.label: Spans F1
metrics.description: Notes under a palm mute, let ring or slur.

metrics.label: Repaired
metrics.description: Readings the validator sent back once before they passed or were dropped.

metrics.label: Truncated
metrics.description: Readings a call of which hit the token cap, mostly while still thinking: the reply was never written, which is not the same as misread.
